notes.title: Release of Farlight Commanders
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After many years of work, Today (19th of novemeber of 2021) we will release our incoming game Farlight Commanders 

As you know, Farlight Commanders will be a little experience or short experience of hadling a spaceship with friends or solo, if the game is liked by the community we coulkd work in more content or a second part.

This is a little game made with a lot of love, I hope you will like it. Remember reviews help a lot!

Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301860/Farlight_Commanders/

notes.title: Game language translation and dialogues
notes.content:
Hello everyone!,

In this new updated we added several languages to the game, the language translation is a work in progress due all the text are not finished, so we decided to make a quick translate to test how the UI is working in different languages. If you find some grammar issues please give us your feedback.

We also added the UI of the dialogue of the games. Our idea is to add some conversations with the different people who is living in this universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39882512/641c686365d52e2812337b939b4377f385e14c39.jpg[/img]

We fixed lot of things, related to emitters crashes and improved the run animation of the players character.

Thank you for your help and feedback!

We hope you like the new update. Don't forget to wishlist the main game and follow us on twitter,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301860/Farlight_Commanders/

We have a pre-kickstarter launch campaign, follow us there, we are near 100 people!

notes.title: The Spaceship AI update
notes.content:
Fellow Commanders,

We are glad to release a new update. The Spaceship AI update.

This update is mainly focus for the single player, I mean, make possible for one player handle the spaceship, if the player character has a good tech skill.

We added the programming skill to the player character, this skill for now is used to allow the player buy better chips for the spaceship AI.
Maybe in the future we could use this skill to control enemy operating systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39882512/097583fa9874fcb495c8e10d61d527949fb19a18.jpg[/img]

We added a new computer in the spaceship where the players can configure the AI, turn on/off it and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39882512/a3ad144873a439e5292657d5b1827daeaf853898.jpg[/img]

As you can see there are two electronic boards, where the player can add or remove chips that will add special skills to the AI, like activate emergency shields, or use emergency batteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39882512/f3bc2580430311dbac153000df880adb5a3aa298.jpg[/img]

We added too somelike of console command for controlling the AI. We designed that to give the feeling that the players is messing with the raw AI core of the spaceship. The player could config some AI parameters and... could talk to the AI and discover a little the lore of the game.

We hope you like the new update. Don't forget to wishlist the main game and follow us on twitter,

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301860/Farlight_Commanders/

We have a pre-kickstarter launch campaign, follow us there, we are near 100 people!

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1609491833/farlight-commanders?ref=card]Kickstarter Pre-campaign[/url][/h1]

Thank you for your support, feedback and reviews, it helps a lot!

notes.title: Enemy visualization and drops
notes.content:
Fellow Commanders,

We released a new update, related to enemy visualization and drops.

Now when the enemy detects a player, the player will see an indicator in the enemy, this is useful in dark places.

We added enemy drops, that means, every ground enemy could drop things, like health, energy, money... for now is only in ground enemies, however We would like to add this feature to space enemies.

We heard the community feedback and we hope to add soon, all the feedback related to tutorial buttons and more in the next updates.

Now, we would like to focus on two big features, dialogues and spaceship AI. We think dialogues could be a good way to explain the lore and story of the game, and keep the player playing more time in order to unfold what it is happening in this universe. And AI spacechip could be a good way to allow single players play the space battles. We hope to have something soon.

Thank you for your feedback and reviews it helps a lot in order to continue improving the game.

notes.title: Enemy fleet mission
notes.content:
Hi!

In this new update I added the enemy fleet mission, it is a mission that will be able to play every day in the game and the enemies in the mission will be random.

I removed the end of the prologue, so the players could play all the time the want, they could test all the mecanics, earn credits and experiencie from the missions and buy all the components they need. 

The idea is that the players could test the core of the game and send me feedback in order to improve the complete game. all your feedback and revies are important to us in order to improve and polish the game.

I hope you enjoy
Thank you!
Kind regards.

notes.title: New planet and public opinion
notes.content:
Hi fellow commanders!

Thank you for all your feedback and reviews, it help me a lot in order to know how to improve the game.

Hearing the players, I added a new planet with 3 more missions, space, aereal and ground. I can wait to hear your feedback.

I changed the opinion public variable, if the players team decrease the public opinion to zero nothing will happen, no end game, now the public opinion will be a modifier for rewards, I mean each day the team will receave an amount of money and experience depending on the value of the public opinion.

I will continue reviewing the code to find bugs and polishing the game.

Thank you again for your support an patience!

notes.title: SIngle player.
notes.content:
Hi!

I've been working on the single player. I changed the health of enemies and right now it is possible to finish the prologue in single player even in the first run if you know well the game.

I will add in the future AI turrets for the spaceship and the possiblitiy of the pilot station could toggle control between piloting the spaceship or use the actions of the other stations like shields, energe..

Thank you!

notes.title: Improving initial steps
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I apologize about the issues, I mean, I think a lot of people is getting stuck in the game, they don't achieve to discover how to use a weapon or lift the spaceship.

I'm working hard to improve all the initial steps. 

-Now the weapon will appear when is selected from the inventory.

-There is a new elevator door in the spaceship and in the sewer, so the players could go first to the spaceship instead of see all the city.

I hope i can help. Please feel free to write here your feedback, so I can improve the game.

Thank you!
